requirements.statement: An employee can submit an expense claim with an amount, category, description and date

criteria.must: An employee can create a claim by providing amount, category, description and date
A submitted claim starts in pending status
The category must be one of the fixed predefined categories
A claim cannot be submitted without an amount, category, description or date

requirements.statement: An employee can attach a receipt to a claim, but it is not required

criteria.must: An employee can attach a receipt file to a claim
A claim can be submitted successfully with no receipt attached

requirements.statement: An employee can view the status of their submitted claims

criteria.must: An employee sees a list of their own submitted claims
Each claim in the list shows its current status (pending, approved or rejected)
An employee cannot see claims submitted by other employees

requirements.statement: An employee can edit and resubmit a claim their manager rejected

criteria.must: A rejected claim shows the manager's rejection reason to the employee
An employee can edit the details of a rejected claim
Resubmitting an edited rejected claim returns it to pending status

requirements.statement: A manager can see a queue of expense claims submitted by their direct reports

criteria.must: A manager sees pending claims submitted by their direct reports
A manager does not see claims from employees who are not their direct reports

requirements.statement: A manager can approve a claim, making it eligible for payroll export

criteria.must: A manager can approve a pending claim from a direct report
An approved claim's status changes to approved
A manager cannot approve a claim from an employee who is not their direct report

requirements.statement: A manager can reject a claim with a reason

criteria.must: A manager can reject a pending claim from a direct report
Rejecting a claim requires a reason
A rejected claim's status changes to rejected

requirements.statement: Finance can view all approved claims

criteria.must: Finance sees a list of all approved claims across all employees
Finance does not see pending or rejected claims in the approved list

requirements.statement: Finance can export approved claims to a downloadable CSV file

criteria.must: Finance can trigger an export that produces a downloadable CSV file
The exported CSV contains the approved claims' data

requirements.statement: Exported claims are marked as exported so they are never exported twice

criteria.must: A claim included in an export is marked as exported
A claim already marked as exported is not included in a subsequent export
